name: tetrate-model-provider
description: Provides language models from Tetrate Agent Router Service to VS Code chat and to other extensions

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension reads no workspace content. The settings that carry the API key to an endpoint are machine-scoped, so a workspace cannot redirect it.

tetrate-model-provider.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible Agent Router endpoint. Change this to target a self-hosted or Enterprise deployment; the URL must end in `/v1`.

Machine-scoped: settable in User settings only. The API key is sent to this host, so a workspace is not allowed to redirect it.

tetrate-model-provider.modelFilter.markdownDescription: Only offer models whose id matches one of these glob patterns, for example `claude-*` or `gpt-5.6-terra`. Leave empty to offer every chat model the API key can reach.

contextWindow.description: Context window in tokens, replacing the catalog value. Intended for models the public catalog does not describe.

maxOutputTokens.description: Output limit in tokens, replacing the catalog value.

maxTokens.description: Hard output cap sent as max_tokens with every request to matching models, unlike maxOutputTokens, which only adjusts the advertised budget. Some OpenAI reasoning models reject max_tokens in favour of max_completion_tokens.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent with every request to matching models.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort sent with every request to matching models. Only meaningful for reasoning models.

tetrate-model-provider.modelOverrides.markdownDescription: Per-model settings, keyed by the same `*` glob patterns as `#tetrate-model-provider.modelFilter#`. When several patterns match one model, later entries win field by field. Example: `{ "claude-*": { "reasoningEffort": "high" } }`.

tetrate-model-provider.requestHeaders.markdownDescription:
Extra HTTP headers to send with every request, for example a routing hint or a tenant identifier. Do not put the API key here — it is kept in secret storage.

Machine-scoped: settable in User settings only. `Authorization` cannot be set here; it is always derived from the stored key.

tetrate-model-provider.profiles.markdownDescription:
Named endpoints for the **Switch Endpoint** command, for example `{ "Production": "https://api.router.tetrate.ai/v1", "Staging": "https://router.tare-staging.tetrate.ai/v1" }`. Each endpoint keeps its own API key.

Machine-scoped: settable in User settings only, since the API key is sent to the selected URL.

tetrate-model-provider.spendWarning.markdownDescription: Raise a warning once the day's estimated Agent Router cost reaches this many dollars. `0` disables the warning. Costs are estimated from the public catalog's prices, so the warning is advisory; the dashboard is the billing authority.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Tetrate Agent Router
walkthroughs.description: Chat with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and more behind one endpoint and one bill.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.description:
An API key is created in the Agent Router dashboard and grants access to every routed model.
[Open the Dashboard](https://router.tetrate.ai/)

steps.title: Store the API key
steps.description:
The key is held in VS Code secret storage, scoped to the endpoint host. It is never written to a settings file.
[Set API Key](command:tetrate-model-provider.setApiKey)

steps.title: Enable models in the picker
steps.description: Models contributed by an extension start out hidden. Run **Chat: Manage Language Models** from the Command Palette, select **Tetrate Agent Router**, and enable the models to offer.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run bundle:prod
